scope: Reviewed variable-name registry attested to cover the supplied export and proposed replacement
coverage_attestation: Locally compared with the privately supplied export on 2026-08-04; public readers cannot independently reproduce that source comparison.

rules.public_registry: Names, classifications, rules, and explicitly safe defaults are versioned here.
rules.secret_values: Secret values exist only in the platform secret store and are never committed or logged.
rules.private_values: Routes, hosts, table names, OAuth identity, and deployment topology remain private even when not credentials.
rules.runtime_logging: Only variables marked value may appear in runtime logs; presence-only is permitted only for a future reviewed diagnostic that emits a boolean.
rules.unknowns: A documented variable does not prove that a live value exists or is correct.

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Declared environment cross-checked against Catalyst SDK runtime metadata before Data Store access; this revision code-blocks Production.

variables.name: BILLING_SOURCE_TIER
variables.description: Test organization for Development or live organization for Production; the HMAC secret and private source alias must bind one exact organization.

variables.name: SOURCE_REVISION
variables.description: Immutable reviewed source revision used for audit correlation.

variables.name: ALLOWED_PATH
variables.description: One exact inbound path; query strings are prohibited.

variables.name: BILLING_CONTENT_TYPE
variables.description: Exact body format configured in Zoho Billing.

variables.name: BILLING_SIGNATURE_ENCODING
variables.description: Hex or Base64 only after a synthetic Billing test-organization delivery proves the provider encoding.

variables.name: BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.description: Current 12-50 character alphanumeric Zoho Billing HMAC key.

variables.name: BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET_PREVIOUS
variables.description: Previous HMAC key retained only for a bounded rotation window.

variables.name: BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET_PREVIOUS_EXPIRES_AT
variables.description: ISO-8601 expiry enforcing a maximum seven-day overlap; an expired prior key is ignored.

variables.name: BILLING_EVENT_FINGERPRINT_SECRET
variables.description: Stable HMAC key for semantic duplicate fingerprints; retain for at least the inbox retention period and rotate only with an approved migration.

variables.name: BILLING_SOURCE_KEY
variables.description: Stable private alias that binds event keys to one Billing source.

variables.name: ALLOWED_EVENT_TYPES
variables.description: Exact subset of documented Billing event names approved for this workflow.

variables.name: BILLING_MAX_EVENT_AGE_SECONDS
variables.description: Maximum signed event age; older manual resends require private reconciliation.

variables.name: BILLING_MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS
variables.description: Maximum future clock skew accepted for the signed Billing event timestamp.

variables.name: MAX_BODY_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum declared and streamed inbound body size.

variables.name: INBOUND_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Maximum time allowed to receive the raw request body.

variables.name: PLATFORM_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-operation limit for Catalyst Data Store, ZCQL, and Connection calls.

variables.name: EXECUTION_BUDGET_MS
variables.description: Composite operation budget capped below Catalyst's 30-second Advanced I/O limit.

variables.name: EVENT_INBOX_TABLE
variables.description: Catalyst Data Store table API name with a unique EVENT_KEY column.

variables.name: DATASTORE_DUPLICATE_ERROR_CODES
variables.description: Exact SDK conflict codes proven by concurrent Development tests; unknown errors fail closed.

variables.name: DELIVERY_MODE
variables.description: Development registration-only or candidate Creator delivery; this source revision rejects every Production configuration.

variables.name: CREATOR_FIELD_ALLOWLIST
variables.description: Optional bounded scalar paths already present in the configured JSON body; Billing's string-valued payload is not parsed.

variables.name: CREATOR_FORWARD_URL
variables.description: Exact HTTPS endpoint implementing the idempotent acknowledgment contract.

variables.name: CREATOR_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Exact Creator hostnames; suffix matching is prohibited.

variables.name: CREATOR_ENDPOINT_KIND
variables.description: Only an OAuth-protected Creator Custom API implementing the readback contract is supported.

variables.name: CREATOR_TARGET_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Asserted Creator target: Development or Stage from Catalyst Development, and Production only from Catalyst Production; live verification remains required.

variables.name: CREATOR_CONNECTION_LINK_NAME
variables.description: Private candidate Connection link name; current Creator credential retrieval is unsupported until the exact pinned-SDK path is proven in Catalyst Development.

variables.name: CREATOR_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Retired because a Creator Custom API does not use the v2.1 Data API environment header; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_URL
variables.description: Raw token refresh is replaced by Catalyst Connections; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ACCOUNTS_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Raw token refresh is replaced by Catalyst Connections; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ZOHO_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Original variable name retained for audit; Catalyst Connection owns the live OAuth identity.

variables.name: ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Original variable name retained for audit; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN
variables.description: Original variable name retained for audit; Catalyst Connection manages token lifecycle.

variables.name: OUTBOUND_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Maximum side-effecting Creator Custom API request duration.

variables.name: MAX_OUTBOUND_BODY_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum OAuth or Creator response body size.

variables.name: OAUTH_TOKEN_SKEW_SECONDS
variables.description: No in-process OAuth cache remains; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: REQUIRE_SHARED_HEADER
variables.description: Enables one additional constant-time custom-header check; HMAC remains mandatory.

variables.name: SHARED_HEADER_NAME
variables.description: Exact lower-case custom header name.

variables.name: SHARED_HEADER_VALUE
variables.description: Additional shared-header secret.

variables.name: ENABLE_REPLAY_DEFENSE
variables.description: May not disable durable idempotency; false causes startup failure.

variables.name: FORWARD_RAW_PAYLOAD
variables.description: Raw forwarding is prohibited; true causes startup failure.

variables.name: REQUIRE_JSON
variables.description: JSON enforcement cannot be disabled.

variables.name: REQUIRE_SIGNATURE
variables.description: Signature verification cannot be disabled.

variables.name: CATALYST_ENV
variables.description: Legacy runtime label is not trusted for routing or event identity.

variables.name: ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Legacy environment label is not trusted.

variables.name: ACCOUNTS_ALLOWED_HOST_SUFFIXES
variables.description: Replaced by exact ACCOUNTS_ALLOWED_HOSTS; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ALLOWED_PATHS
variables.description: Multiple route candidates are not accepted; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: CREATOR_ALLOWED_HOST_SUFFIXES
variables.description: Replaced by exact CREATOR_ALLOWED_HOSTS; any value causes startup failure.

variables.name: ENABLE_PING
variables.description: The unauthenticated special route was removed.

variables.name: FORWARD_PARSED_BILLING
variables.description: Replaced by mandatory scalar allowlisting and normalization.

variables.name: PING_TOKEN
variables.description: Removed with the ping bypass.

variables.name: REPLAY_CACHE_SEGMENT_ID
variables.description: Ephemeral Cache is not the idempotency ledger.

variables.name: REPLAY_KEY_PREFIX
variables.description: Replaced by the stable source-bound event-key derivation.

variables.name: REPLAY_WINDOW_SECONDS
variables.description: A time-limited cache window cannot establish durable idempotency.

variables.name: ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_DOMAIN
variables.description: Replaced by an exact HTTPS URL and exact-host allowlist.

variables.name: GATEWAY_VERSION
variables.description: Replaced by immutable SOURCE_REVISION.
